bmad-architecture.label: Decide the technical design
bmad-architecture.description: Record the technical decisions that keep separately built parts working together.

next.label: Add these decisions to the spec

bmad-prd.label: Write the requirements
bmad-prd.description: Work out in detail what the product must do, for whom, and how you will know it works.

next.label: Turn these requirements into a spec

bmad-product-brief.label: Describe your idea
bmad-product-brief.description: Write down who it is for, the problem it solves and why it matters, in a short brief.

next.label: Turn this brief into a spec

bmad-spec.label: Write the spec
bmad-spec.description: Condense your idea, notes or documents into a short spec that every build reads.

bmad-ticket.label: Plan the work in tickets
bmad-ticket.description: Split the work into epics and stories, and keep track of where each one stands.

bmad-ux.label: Design how it looks and works
bmad-ux.description: Describe the look, the screens and the flows people will use.

next.label: Turn this design into a spec

bmad-build.label: Build a change with you
bmad-build.description: Plan, build, review and check one story, fix or feature, with you deciding along the way.

bmad-build-auto.label: Build next story
bmad-build-auto.description: Build one ready story on its own, with nobody watching, and stop for review.

bmad-code-review.label: Review code changes
bmad-code-review.description: Have several reviewers check a change, then sort what they found.

bmad-project-context.label: Set up instructions for agents
bmad-project-context.description: Keep this project's instructions for coding agents short, current and correct.

bmad-qa-generate-e2e-tests.label: Add end-to-end tests
bmad-qa-generate-e2e-tests.description: Write automated tests that check a finished feature works from start to finish.

bmad-retrospective.label: Look back on an epic
bmad-retrospective.description: Check a finished epic against what it promised and list what to change next time.

bmad-review.label: Review a document or change
bmad-review.description: Check a diff or a document for problems through one or more review lenses.

bmad-walkthrough.label: Walk through a change
bmad-walkthrough.description: Go through a commit, pull request or folder together, one piece at a time.

bmad-advanced-elicitation.label: Push the last answer further
bmad-advanced-elicitation.description: Ask the agent to rethink and improve what it just wrote.

bmad-brainstorming.label: Brainstorm ideas
bmad-brainstorming.description: Come up with ideas using a range of creative techniques.

bmad-deep-recon.label: Research a topic
bmad-deep-recon.description: Gather sources and a short summary with citations to help you decide.

bmad-forge-idea.label: Pressure-test an idea
bmad-forge-idea.description: Question a half-formed idea from several angles until you can act on it or drop it.

bmad-prfaq.label: Test whether it is worth building
bmad-prfaq.description: Write the announcement first, then answer the hard questions customers and your team would ask.

bmad-agent-analyst.label: Talk to the business analyst
bmad-agent-analyst.description: Think through markets, competitors and requirements with an analyst.

bmad-agent-architect.label: Talk to the architect
bmad-agent-architect.description: Weigh technical choices and their trade-offs with a system architect.

bmad-agent-dev.label: Talk to the developer
bmad-agent-dev.description: Plan and build code changes with a senior engineer.

bmad-agent-pm.label: Talk to the product manager
bmad-agent-pm.description: Work out what to build and why with a product manager.

bmad-agent-ux-designer.label: Talk to the UX designer
bmad-agent-ux-designer.description: Think through screens, flows and the people using them with a designer.

bmad-party-mode.label: Talk to a group of agents
bmad-party-mode.description: Hear several agents discuss your question together.

bmad.label: Ask for help or set up
bmad.description: Ask what to do next, or set up and update BMad Method in this project.

bmad-correct-course.label: Change course
bmad-correct-course.description: Work out what a big change in the middle of the work means for the plans, and propose the update.

bmad-customize.label: Customize a skill
bmad-customize.description: Change how an installed skill or agent behaves in this project.
